data.desc: NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) develops software-orchestrated, hardware-enabled systems for defense and security, critical infrastructure and digital resilience. Its dual-use Defense & Security platform brings together directed-energy and other non-kinetic technologies, electronic warfare and defense mobility, operational resilience software, and advanced manufacturing and sustainment. NUBURU seeks to integrate these modular capabilities around customer requirements and support them over their operational life.
